purpose: Enroll the Sender from a scanned or typed enrollment offer under the Operator-mediated Wire Protocol Version 1 lifecycle, adopt advertised capabilities, and drain, unlink, or destructively reset its own installation: require a secure screen lock, create a durable opaque installation identity, its fingerprint, and a non-exportable installation key, send one byte-stable enrollment confirmation until the Portal answers, adopt the advertised capability generation and acknowledge it as the installation's first Outbox Message, learn the Operator's confirmation from that acknowledgement's receipt, supply the staging and delivery contexts, adopt later generations only before draining, drain by stopping new messages and reporting the final sequence once the Outbox is empty, and destroy the local key and state only on explicit intent.

inputs.name: enrollment_offer
inputs.description: A scanned enrollment-offer message, or a typed Portal URL and enrollment code.

inputs.name: operator_intent
inputs.description: The Operator's request on the Sender to enroll, drain, unlink after the Portal retired the installation, or destructively reset with acknowledged possible loss.

inputs.name: secure_lock
inputs.description: Whether the Device has a secure screen lock, read through the installation cipher when enrolling.

inputs.name: identity_source
inputs.description: A random UUID source for the new installation identity.

inputs.name: installation_key
inputs.description: The installation cipher: creating, sealing with, and deleting the non-exportable installation key.

inputs.name: portal_transport
inputs.description: A seam that performs one HTTP request to the Portal's enrollment-confirmation or capabilities route and returns its response body, or reports that no response arrived.

inputs.name: portal_response
inputs.description: The Portal's answer: a capability advertisement, a retryable failure, any other body, or no response.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: this unit's enrollment state, stage-outbox-batch@1's Outbox, and, on destruction, every Sender table, behind the 3ug seam and storage lane.

inputs.name: clock
inputs.description: The Sender wall clock for the enrollment and adoption times.

outputs.name: installation_identity
outputs.description: A durable opaque installation identity, its fingerprint for the Operator to compare, a non-exportable installation key under an identity-derived alias, and the exact enrollment-confirmation bytes resent on every attempt.

outputs.name: enrollment_state
outputs.description: The installation's local phase (confirming, refused, enrolled, or draining), its adopted capability advertisement and generation, whether the Operator's confirmation has been learned, and the drained final sequence once the Outbox is empty.

outputs.name: capability_acknowledgement
outputs.description: A byte-stable capability acknowledgement appended through stage-outbox-batch@1's Outbox, sealed with the installation key, atomically with each adopted generation; the first is the installation's first Outbox Message.

outputs.name: sync_contexts
outputs.description: The staging context (installation, key alias, and adopted generation's limits and schemas) and the delivery context (installation, key alias, and Portal URL) that the shell supplies to the stage and delivery units.

outputs.name: local_destruction
outputs.description: On unlink after a complete drain, or on destructive reset with acknowledged possible loss, deletion of the installation key and every row of every Sender table, keeping the schema.

observable_effects.name: installation-key-lifecycle
observable_effects.description: Creates the installation key when enrolling, seals capability acknowledgements with it, and deletes it only on unlink or destructive reset.

observable_effects.name: portal-enrollment-request
observable_effects.description: Sends at most one HTTP request per confirmation or capability-refresh attempt.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration, writes its own enrollment state, appends capability acknowledgements through stage-outbox-batch@1, and on destruction deletes every row of every Sender table.

owns: the Sender's local enrollment lifecycle: confirming, refused, enrolled, and draining, and destruction
creating the installation identity, fingerprint, key alias, and the exact enrollment-confirmation bytes
the confirmation and capability requests' method, path, content type, timeout, and largest answer read
adopting a capability generation, deriving the staging generation from it, and acknowledging it
learning the Operator's confirmation from the first acknowledgement's receipt
the drained final sequence, and the unlink and destructive-reset rules
does_not_own: wire schemas, the enrollment-offer, enrollment-confirmation, capability-advertisement, and capability-acknowledgement messages, and fingerprints, which belong to ingest-protocol
the Sender Outbox's schema, sealing, AAD, sequences, and high-water mark, which belong to stage-outbox-batch
enrollment offers, confirmation answers, Operator confirmation, draining, retirement, and capability generations in the Portal, which belong to manage-sender-installation
delivering the acknowledgement and every other Outbox Message, which belongs to send-outbox-message
Polling Runs and pausing collection, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync
the HTTP client, timeout enforcement, QR scanning, Sender screens, the native Keystore module, and when to refresh capabilities, which belong to the Sender shell enabling task
